method_note: Independent bounded C1 visual review: 72 assigned claims across 18 current targets. I covers Structure/VisualConformance/VisualQuality; J covers Craft. Actual source and supplied raw renders were inspected, not builder integration-observations.md. R report was consulted for its exact claim scope, not used as substitute observations.
actual_use_details: Applied pinned JOEDESIGN core, operation RACI and visual-translation to separate Product meaning, approved reference relationships, Craft details and whole-screen judgment. Applied visual-production to the actual twelve-row planning scale and new named participant groups rather than inferring quality from palette or geometry alone.

Applied Impeccable critique hierarchy, scan path, semantic grouping, repeated-role consistency and whole-screen competing-weight checks to every current target image. DEGRADED single-context specialist critique within the assigned independent C1 role: no nested agents were allowed, so this is not the full standalone multi-agent critique workflow or score.

Impeccable context.mjs had already run once earlier in this continuous specialist session; its once-per-session requirement was preserved. Current detect.mjs was run separately against planning.html, participants.html and index.html; raw output is impeccable-detect.json. Missing parser modules force regex fallback: no findings in the first two files is not a clean bill of health. Its overview Arial overused-font warning is subordinate to the explicit approved Arial source and does not justify a redesign.

Inspected all 18 current full.png captures and matching observation.json raw facts/measurements, plus detailed narrow planning result images and the original wide/narrow references. Recomputed every captured frame hash and every available served-source hash against current bytes; evidence-bindings.json preserves the comparisons.
